# Leaflet 1.9.4

Distribution JS and CSS (CSS/license line endings and trailing whitespace normalized) from https://unpkg.com/leaflet@1.9.4/dist/.
The copyright notice in leaflet.js is preserved. License: BSD-2-Clause.
Local assets remove the previous map-library CDN dependency. This app uses vector layers; Leaflet's optional default marker images are not used.
